notes: Deploy persistent 15-minute generic Astra quota retry across all future A2Z campaign tasks, safely using existing model service. Strict status/phase/id/safety filtering, no bridge/executor changes.

operations.content:
[Unit]
Description=Prediction A2Z Astra paused review retry sweep
After=default.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/prediction-project-executor/a2z_astra_retry_sweep.py
TimeoutStartSec=180
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Unit]
Description=Prediction A2Z all-campaign Astra review retry every 15 minutes

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/15
Persistent=true
Unit=prediction-a2z-astra-retry-sweep.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

"""Regression: new campaign tasks are swept without per-instance timer enable."""
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import importlib.util
import json
import sqlite3
import unittest

MODULE=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"jobs/a2z_astra_retry_sweep.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("a2z_astra_retry_sweep",MODULE)
retry=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(retry)


class RetrySweepTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_paused_new_experiment_and_fail_closed(self):
        with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp)
            camp=root/"FUTURE-CAMPAIGN"
            for p in ("models","requests","model_results"):
                (camp/p).mkdir(parents=True)
            with sqlite3.connect(camp/"models/runtime.sqlite") as db:
                db.execute("create table tasks(id text primary key,status text)")
                for tid,status in (("A2Z-NEW-PREBUILD","PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT"),
                                   ("A2Z-DONE-POSTBUILD","COMPLETE"),
                                   ("A2Z-UNSAFE","PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT")):
                    db.execute("insert into tasks values(?,?)",(tid,status))
            base={"phase":"ASTRA_PREBUILD","route_task_id":"SESSION-ROUTE-test",
                  "live_trading":False,"paid_actions":False,"wallet_actions":False}
            for tid in ("A2Z-NEW-PREBUILD","A2Z-DONE-POSTBUILD","A2Z-UNSAFE"):
                (camp/"requests"/(tid+".json")).write_text(json.dumps({**base,"task_id":tid,
                    "live_trading":tid=="A2Z-UNSAFE"}))
            found=list(retry.candidates(root))
            self.assertEqual(found,[("A2Z-NEW-PREBUILD","PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT")])
            called=[]
            class Result: returncode=0
            def fake_run(args,**kwargs):
                called.append(args)
                return Result()
            self.assertEqual(retry.tick(root,run=fake_run),0)
            self.assertEqual(called,[["systemctl","--user","start",
              "prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-NEW-PREBUILD.service"]])


if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
